title: EXP-074 - Hello World Part 5 Prerequisite A: Add the Nullable FX_Address Column to dbo.FX_HelloWorld01
objective: Hello World Part 5 joins Orders to Customer and shows the customer Name and Address. The factory customer table dbo.FX_HelloWorld01 (EXP-040) has FX_Code and FX_Label but no Address column (hello-world-pt1.md Section 6 has Address, String, length 150). Operator decision 2026-10-13: add it. Using the native Web Client SQL Tables runtime Form and the EXP-059 route (Columns, New), retrieve exactly one dbo.FX_HelloWorld01 table and record its complete column baseline; add exactly one column FX_Address with data type nvarchar, Length 150 and Is Nullable checked; verify it before exactly one ordinary Save; close and reopen SQL Tables once, retrieve dbo.FX_HelloWorld01 again and prove the recovered inventory equals the baseline plus FX_Address. Finally open the FX_HelloWorld01 runtime Form once, read-only, and verify that its two records FX001 / Factory test one and FX002 / Factory test two still load. The IDO property and Form field are later experiments. Findings are observed only.
